description: Agent Events: submit an event brief with the organizer’s requirements or commissioning note for the event: the brief with the event, its purpose, audience, format, first and last day, capacity and organizer as it states them; the requirements with their reference, the event and the same fields as they state them. The signed report gives the brief and the requirements, the purpose, audience and format read by their words, the dates read as days, the capacity as a count and the organizer read as a party on each side, and counts them, and names a divergent brief: another date, a capacity below the requirements, another format or audience and another organizer; then a capacity above the requirements, another purpose and another event name, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A field the requirements state and the brief leaves out, or requirements that state none of the six fields, leaves the brief unverified. Phrases match when one holds the other on whole words with plurals folded, and organizers match without case, punctuation or a legal suffix. This reads an event brief against the organizer’s own requirements: wever_meeting-brief reads meeting notes or a transcript and states the decisions, action items and open questions, and a meeting’s notes are not an organized event’s records, so this family summarizes no meeting, while the brief check reads an event brief against the organizer’s own requirements; and wever_hire-brief-check reads a hiring brief against the job record it answers, while the brief check reads an event’s purpose, audience, format, dates, capacity and organizer against the commissioning note. Verdict event_brief_divergent, event_brief_partial, event_brief_unverified or event_brief_consistent. POST /api/event-brief-check. Reads the event records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only: it never books a venue, registers or invites anyone, sells or refunds a ticket, publishes an announcement, or judges whether an event should happen, was well run, or was worth attending, only whether its records agree with each other and with what was announced, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Events reads an organized event’s records for consistency between documents: an event brief, a published agenda, speaker confirmations, a registration list, a venue arrangement, a ticketing record, a public announcement and a post-event report, each against the requirements, plan, lineup, capacity and eligibility terms, brief, announced terms, schedule or records it should agree with. Beside it, the Standing jobs rail tools such as wever_schedule-create register, list, report on and cancel recurring jobs and keep state, and wever_meeting-brief states one meeting’s decisions and action items from its notes, while this family keeps no state, registers nothing, runs nothing and reads the records in the call against each other and against what was announced. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-events-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-events/.
